attchmntText: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Ethos Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 30.1% year-on-year to Rs. 498.9 crore. For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue increased 31.6% to Rs. 960.6 crore. Consolidated EBITDA for H1 FY27 rose 31.4% to Rs. 105.4 crore. Consolidated PBT for H1 FY27 increased 32.4% to Rs. 85.7 crore. The company opened 12 boutiques during the period, bringing the total network to 106 boutiques across 35 cities. A one-time expenditure of Rs. 4.5 crore was incurred for the GPHG Exhibition in Q2 FY27. The presentation was submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Ethos Limited reports no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds from its Rights Issue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company raised up to Rs 40,990.50 lakh on July 04, 2025. Funds were allocated to funding working capital requirements, general corporate purposes, and issue-related expenses. As of the report date, Rs 20,603.47 lakh was utilized for working capital, Rs 375.49 lakh for issue-related expenses, and no proceeds were used for general corporate purposes during the quarter. The monitoring agency is CRISIL Ratings Limited. The Audit Committee and auditors have raised no comments. The statement is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: Ethos Limited has placed before shareholders the re-appointment of Mr. Pranav Shankar Saboo, DIN 03391925, as Managing Director. The Board of Directors considered this proposal at its meeting held on November 12, 2026. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval. The term is three years, commencing April 1, 2027, and ending March 31, 2030. Remuneration and other terms are as recommended by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Mr. Saboo has been associated with the company since 2015. He is related to Mr. Yashovardhan Saboo, who serves as a Whole-Time Director. The company confirms that Mr. Saboo has not been debarred from holding office as a Director by SEBI or any other authority. Details regarding the appointment are enclosed as Annexure I.

attchmntText: Ethos Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ethos Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board proposed the re-appointment of Mr. Pranav Shankar Saboo, DIN 03391925, as Managing Director for a term of 3 years commencing April 1, 2027, and ending March 31, 2030. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval. The Board approved the notice for a postal ballot via remote e-voting and authorized the Company Secretary or Key Managerial Personnel to decide the cut-off date and dispatch the notice. M/s. Jaspreet Singh Dhawan & Associates, FCS 8545, was appointed as the Scrutinizer for the postal ballot process. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026.
